title: Focused launcher recognizer rejects --request-message-id, so a remote causal focused run never gets a provider observation or native completion
outcome: A focused launcher run started with --request-message-id is recognized as a test command, gets its provider observation, retains its native completion, and its causal remote credit can settle on the requester.
acceptance: engram_focused_launcher_words accepts exactly one --request-message-id with a validated value and refuses a duplicate, shown by tests.

A regression through the real provider-observation boundary shows that a focused `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused --input commit --request-message-id <relay id> -- …` command is recognized, observed and retains a native completion, including on a runner whose project has Engram enabled:false.
Existing recognition, causal completion and admission tests stay green.
